basic.name: Yifei Bao

Honored with multiple scholarships and holder of a patent in flood disaster prediction.

skills.professional: Proficient in Python, Pytorch, Machine Learning techniques. Experience in LLM Application (Agent, RAG), Data Science, Computer Vision techniques and Git-based collaborative workflows.

experience.title: AI Engineer Intern
experience.description: Architecting agentic systems and fine-tuning multimodal VLMs for artwork analysis at Harvard Arts Museum.
responsibilities: Agentic System: Architected an interactive artwork image analysis agent that processes user-uploaded images, using an LLM-based planner to dynamically orchestrate 20+ vision & language models/APIs (Qwen-VL, BLIP-2, GPT-4o, Gemini, YOLOv8), producing structured metadata and descriptions; cut inference costs by 40% per request and improved speed by 58%.

VLM Fine-Tuning: Fine-tuned a multimodal VLM (Qwen2.5-VL-7B) on the human-annotated artwork description dataset using SFT with LoRA techniques, using training optimization strategies such as warm-up scheduling, cosine LR decay, BF16 mixed precision training, and gradient accumulation. Applied multimodal models (ViT, Qwen-VL) on 385K+ high-resolution artwork images, generating 70M+ tags/descriptions.
